name: ask_location
description: Ask the person where they are, when an answer depends on it (places near them, directions, the weather there). Show why you ask, a button sharing their device's location once, for this answer, and one saying no; a chat without buttons (WhatsApp) asks them to share a location pin or say where they are. Reply with the coordinates when shared, or with the place they typed; shared is false when they said no. A place shared or said earlier is where they were then: ask again whenever the answer depends on where they are now, never reuse it and never guess.

reason.description: Why you ask, said to the person, e.g. To find restaurants near you

accuracyMeters.description: How close the position is, in metres

place.description: Where they are in their own words, or the location line a chat without buttons sent

shared.description: Whether the person shared where they are; false when they said no
